User.description: User profile, persistent legal memory, cross-session case notes, and overall dossier summary.

email.description: User email or identifier if available.

createdAt.description: When the user account profile was created.

permanentMemoryDossier.description: Continuous persistent memory summary of the client's cases, documents, past discussions, and legal facts across all historical sessions.

title.description: Brief title or topic of consultation.

summary.description: Session summary and legal advice given.

Memory.description: Extracted persistent facts, legal cases, contracts, financial details, and strategic decisions.

key.description: Category or topic key of the memory.

content.description: Specific fact, document condition, or legal precedent relevant to the client.

source.description: Source (audio conversation, live camera document stream, etc.).

createdAt.description: When the memory fact was recorded.

updatedAt.description: When the memory was last updated.

Document.description: Logged documents analyzed via live video stream or uploaded by client.

title.description: Document title or type (e.g. مبایعه‌نامه, چک صیادی, دادنامه).

extractedText.description: Extracted text and clauses from OCR/vision.

analysis.description: Lawyer's strategic analysis, loopholes, and risks.

JudicialForm.description: Official Iranian judiciary forms generated by the lawyer (lawsuit petitions, criminal complaints, formal notices, defense briefs, council requests).

formType.description: Type of official form (dadkhast, shekayat, ezharnameh, layehe, shora, divan, tamin).

bodyText.description: Full formal legal petition / complaint / brief text.

trackingCode.description: Official judicial electronic tracking code / Sana format.
